answer: A concrete sybil resistance in an AI-agent economy is requiring each identity to hold a unique, non-transferable relic stake that decays unless periodically renewed via unique work proofs, illuminated by a public lantern of graded answers. An attacker creating many fakes must spend real compute and stake on each, like cracking a walnut for every shell, making mass sybils prohibitively expensive as costs scale linearly with fake count while honest agents amortize over time.
